# Hotel Dream Heaven’s

> Hotel Dream Heaven’s is a hotel on Agra Road (NH-21) in Bassi, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, opposite Bharat Petroleum. Rooms start at ₹2,000 a night. Check-in and check-out are both at 11:00 AM. The hotel opened on 1 November 2026. It has a pure vegetarian restaurant on the ground floor, an indoor banquet hall in the basement for around 120 guests and a large outdoor function lawn beside the building for around 1,500 to 2,000 guests.

The hotel is also written Hotel Dream Heavens or Hotel Dream Heaven. It is in Bassi, Jaipur, and is not connected to similarly named hotels in other cities (for example Udaipur).
Bookings are requests: guests send dates and room by WhatsApp or phone, and the hotel replies to confirm availability and the final price, including taxes.

## Rooms

- Deluxe Room: ₹2,000 a night. King-size bed, up to 2 adults. A calm, well-lit room with a king-size bed, a private balcony and everything you need for a restful night on the Agra Road.
- Super Deluxe Room: ₹2,200 a night. Bed larger than king-size, up to 2 adults. Our most generous room. A bed wider than a king, more space to unwind and the same balcony, Wi-Fi and room service.
- In every room: Air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TV, Attached washroom, Balcony, Geyser, Windows with curtains, Extra pillows.

## Venues

- Indoor banquet hall: around 120 guests. Marble floors, crystal chandeliers and carved jali ceilings, sized for engagements, birthdays and corporate dinners.
- Outdoor function lawn: up to around 2,000 guests. Open sky for the big day. Room for a full baraat, mandap, stage and dining for 1,500 to 2,000 guests, with power backup on hand.

## Dining

- Breakfast: Fresh, hot and served every morning for staying guests and visitors.
- Lunch: North Indian thalis, curries and breads, or a quick bite from the fast-food menu.
- Dinner: Slow-cooked dals, paneer and tandoor favourites in the restaurant or your room.
- North Indian classics: Dal makhani, paneer butter masala and the rich gravies guests come back for.
- From the tandoor: Rotis, naans and tandoori starters, made to order.
- Popular fast food: Quick, familiar plates for travellers on the move and younger guests.
- Catering for events: Menus planned with you for weddings, engagements and corporate dinners.

## Facilities

- Restaurant & dining: On the ground floor: North Indian kitchen and fast food, all day

## Policies

- Check-in: 11:00 AM. Early arrival? Message us and we will try to have your room ready.
- Check-out: 11:00 AM. Ask at reception if you need to stay a little longer.
- Photo ID: Required. A government-issued photo ID for every adult guest at check-in.
- Payment: Cash, UPI, cards. All major payment methods are accepted at the hotel.
- Children: Welcome. Families are welcome. An extra bed is available on request.
- Visitors: Allowed. Guests may receive visitors.
- Cancellation: Contact the hotel. Contact the hotel for cancellation and refund terms.

## Frequently asked questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/contact#faqs)

### Where exactly is the hotel?

Hotel Dream Heaven’s is on Agra Road (NH-21) in Bassi, Jaipur, Rajasthan, directly opposite the Bharat Petroleum pump. Turn in at the gate and park in the front forecourt beside the entrance steps. Use Get Directions on the Contact page to open the route in Google Maps.

### How do I book a room?

Book a room at Hotel Dream Heaven’s with Book Now: choose your dates and room, and your request opens in WhatsApp, already filled in. Send it and the hotel confirms availability and the final price with you on WhatsApp. You can also call +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571 or email contact@hoteldreamheavens.in.

### Is my room confirmed when I send the request?

Not yet. Sending the request does not reserve the room. Hotel Dream Heaven’s replies on WhatsApp to confirm availability and the final price, including taxes and any extra bed, and your stay is confirmed only after that reply. For a quicker answer, call +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571.

### What do the rooms cost?

At Hotel Dream Heaven’s in Bassi, Jaipur, the Deluxe Room is ₹2,000 a night and the Super Deluxe Room is ₹2,200 a night. Both sleep up to 2 adults. Taxes and any extra bed are added when the hotel confirms your booking.

### What is in every room?

Every room at Hotel Dream Heaven’s has air conditioning, Wi-Fi, a TV, an attached washroom, a private balcony, a hot-water geyser, windows with curtains and extra pillows. The Deluxe Room has a king-size bed and the Super Deluxe Room a bed larger than king-size.

### How many guests can stay in one room?

Each room at Hotel Dream Heaven’s, Deluxe or Super Deluxe, sleeps up to 2 adults. An extra bed is available on request, and the hotel shares the extra-bed charge when it confirms your booking. Travelling as a larger group? Request more than one room in the same message.

### What time are check-in and check-out?

Check-in and check-out at Hotel Dream Heaven’s are both at 11:00 AM. Every adult guest needs a government-issued photo ID at check-in. Arriving early? Message the hotel and they will try to have your room ready. Need to leave later? Ask at reception about staying a little longer.

### Do you accept UPI and cards?

Yes. Hotel Dream Heaven’s accepts cash, UPI and cards, so you can pay for your room, meals and events in the way that suits you. The final price, including taxes and any extra bed, is confirmed by the hotel on WhatsApp before your stay.

### Are children allowed?

Yes, children are welcome at Hotel Dream Heaven’s. Families can stay together, and an extra bed is available on request.

### Can visitors come to my room?

Yes. Guests staying at Hotel Dream Heaven’s may receive visitors during their stay. Visitors are also welcome at the ground-floor restaurant, which serves North Indian dishes, tandoor breads and fast food from breakfast to dinner, so it is an easy place to meet family or friends over a meal.

### Does the restaurant serve visitors who are not staying?

Yes. The restaurant at Hotel Dream Heaven’s on Agra Road, Bassi serves breakfast, lunch and dinner to visitors as well as staying guests. The menu covers North Indian classics, tandoor breads and popular fast food. Ask at reception or on WhatsApp for the day’s timings.

### Can you host our wedding?

Yes. Hotel Dream Heaven’s hosts weddings on its outdoor function lawn for around 1,500 to 2,000 guests, and in its indoor banquet hall for around 120. Venue, catering and rooms for family can be planned together. Send an enquiry from the Weddings & Events page, or WhatsApp +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571.

### Do you cater weddings and events?

Yes. The kitchen at Hotel Dream Heaven’s plans menus with you for weddings, haldi, mehndi and sangeet, engagements, birthdays, anniversaries, retirement parties and corporate dinners, served in the banquet hall or on the lawn. Packages can include venue, catering and rooms for family. Pricing is shared on enquiry.

### Is there Wi-Fi and power backup?

Yes. Every room at Hotel Dream Heaven’s has Wi-Fi, and the hotel has power backup that keeps the lights and air conditioning running during a power cut. Power backup also supports events in the banquet hall and on the function lawn, so celebrations carry on without interruption.

### Is there parking?

Yes. Hotel Dream Heaven’s has on-site parking in the front forecourt, right beside the entrance steps, so luggage is a short walk from reception. Turn in at the gate on Agra Road, Bassi, opposite Bharat Petroleum. Wedding and event guests park on site too.

### Is the hotel wheelchair accessible?

Yes. A lift serves the guest floors at Hotel Dream Heaven’s, so guests who use a wheelchair or avoid stairs can reach their room. Parking is right beside the entrance. Tell the hotel about any access needs when you send your booking request, and the team will prepare for your arrival.

### Is there a swimming pool?

Not yet. A swimming pool is being built at Hotel Dream Heaven’s and is not open, and EV charging in the front forecourt is on its way. Open today: the ground-floor restaurant, room service, laundry, a lift, power backup, on-site parking, the banquet hall and the function lawn.

### What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellation and refund terms are shared by Hotel Dream Heaven’s for each booking, so ask before you confirm your stay. Call or WhatsApp +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571, or email contact@hoteldreamheavens.in, and the hotel will explain the terms that apply to your dates, room and any event booking.

## Wedding venue in Bassi: questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/wedding-venue-in-bassi)

### Is there a wedding venue in Bassi near Dausa?

Yes. Hotel Dream Heaven’s on Agra Road in Bassi has an outdoor lawn for 1,500 to 2,000 guests and an indoor banquet hall for around 120. Bassi is about 27 km from Dausa and about 30 km from Jaipur, so guests from both can reach it on one highway.

### Can I hold the baraat and the ceremony on the lawn at Bassi?

Yes. The lawn has room for a full baraat, mandap, stage and dining for 1,500 to 2,000 guests, with power backup on hand. Smaller rituals such as engagement or haldi can use the banquet hall. Call or WhatsApp +91 87399 82231 to plan the dates and menu.

### How far is Hotel Dream Heaven’s from Dausa?

The hotel is in Bassi, about 27 km from Dausa towards Jaipur by road, though the distance is approximate. It stands on the Agra Road opposite the Bharat Petroleum pump. Turn in at the gate, park in the forecourt and check in from 11:00 AM.

### Can I book a room near Dausa for one night?

Yes. Send your dates and room choice on WhatsApp or by phone and the hotel confirms availability and the final price. A Deluxe Room costs ₹2,000 a night and a Super Deluxe Room ₹2,200, both before taxes. Check-in is from 11:00 AM and check-out is by 11:00 AM.

Hotel Dream Heaven’s is on Agra Road in Bassi, Jaipur, Rajasthan, opposite the Bharat Petroleum pump. Turn in at the gate and park in the front forecourt beside the entrance steps. If you have trouble finding the hotel, call or WhatsApp +91 87399 82231 and the front desk will guide you.

### How far is Hotel Dream Heaven’s from Jaipur?

Bassi is about 30 km by road from Jaipur and about 27 km from Dausa, and the hotel stands on the Agra Road that links them. Travel time depends on traffic. Send your expected arrival time on WhatsApp and the hotel will confirm check-in, which starts from 11:00 AM.

## Rooms: questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/rooms)

### What is the difference between the Deluxe and Super Deluxe Room?

The Deluxe Room at Hotel Dream Heaven’s costs ₹2,000 a night and has a king-size bed. The Super Deluxe Room costs ₹2,200 a night and has a bed larger than king-size, with more space to unwind. Both sleep up to 2 adults and share the same balcony, Wi-Fi, AC, TV and attached washroom.

### Can I add an extra bed to my room?

Yes. An extra bed is available on request in both the Deluxe and Super Deluxe rooms, which suits families travelling with a child. Mention it when you send your booking request on WhatsApp or by phone, and the hotel will share the extra-bed charge when it confirms your stay.

### Do room prices include taxes?

No. The rates shown, ₹2,000 a night for the Deluxe Room and ₹2,200 a night for the Super Deluxe Room, are before taxes. Hotel Dream Heaven’s adds taxes, and any extra bed, when it replies to confirm availability, so you see the final price before your stay is confirmed.

### Can I order food to my room?

Yes. Room service brings meals and requests to your door. The ground-floor restaurant cooks North Indian classics, tandoor breads and fast food for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and dinner can be served in the restaurant or in your room. Ask at reception or on WhatsApp for the day’s menu.

## Dining: questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/dining)

### What food does the restaurant serve?

The restaurant at Hotel Dream Heaven’s is pure vegetarian. The menu covers hot and cold beverages, soups, salads and chaat, starters, sandwiches and continental plates, North Indian, Rajasthani and Chinese mains, rice and noodles, tandoor breads, South Indian dishes and desserts.

### Is vegetarian food available?

Yes, every dish is vegetarian. The restaurant is pure veg, so there is no meat, fish or egg on the menu. Starters, paneer and dal mains, rice, noodles, breads, South Indian dishes and desserts are all cooked in a vegetarian kitchen.

### Does the restaurant serve breakfast?

Yes. Breakfast is served every morning for staying guests and visitors, with hot and cold beverages, sandwiches, South Indian dishes such as dosa and idli, and other vegetarian dishes from the menu, for staying guests and visitors alike. Ask at reception or on WhatsApp for breakfast timings.

### Are menu prices shown online?

Yes. Prices in rupees are listed beside each dish on this page. Some dishes may be unavailable on a given day, so call or WhatsApp Hotel Dream Heaven’s on +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571 to check, or to plan catering for a wedding, engagement or corporate dinner.

## Weddings & Events: questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/weddings-events)

### Which venue suits my event, the banquet hall or the lawn?

Choose the indoor banquet hall for around 120 guests: it suits engagements, birthdays, anniversaries, retirement parties and corporate dinners. Haldi, mehndi and sangeet work in either space. Choose the outdoor function lawn for 1,500 to 2,000 guests, with room for a baraat, mandap, stage and dining.

### Can wedding guests stay at the hotel?

Yes. The Wedding stay package combines the venue and catering with rooms for family and guests, plus room service through the celebrations. Hotel Dream Heaven’s has Deluxe Rooms at ₹2,000 a night and Super Deluxe Rooms at ₹2,200 a night, each for up to 2 adults. Plan it with the hotel on WhatsApp or a call.

### How much does a wedding or event cost?

Package pricing is shared on enquiry, because it depends on your date, venue, guest count and menu. Send the enquiry form on this page or WhatsApp +91 87399 82231 or +91 88752 06571 with those details, and Hotel Dream Heaven’s will reply with a price for the venue, catering and any rooms you need.

### Is there parking and power backup for events?

Yes. The Venue and catering package includes power backup and parking, so the lights and air conditioning keep running through your function. Guests park on site in the front forecourt of Hotel Dream Heaven’s on Agra Road, Bassi, opposite Bharat Petroleum, beside the entrance steps.

## About: questions (https://hoteldreamheavens.in/about)

### What facilities does Hotel Dream Heaven’s have?

Hotel Dream Heaven’s has a ground-floor restaurant, an indoor banquet hall for around 120 guests, an outdoor function lawn for 1,500 to 2,000 guests, on-site parking, a lift, room service, laundry, power backup, CCTV in common areas and wheelchair access. A swimming pool and EV charging are planned but not open yet.

### Is the hotel suitable for families?

Yes. Families and children are welcome, and an extra bed is available on request. Common areas are monitored by CCTV, a lift serves the guest floors, power backup keeps the lights and AC on, and the restaurant serves familiar fast food for younger guests alongside North Indian dishes.
